scope: Owned Xvfb only; original large-command inputs and acceptance unchanged
question: Does a keyboard-focus failure coincide with X11 focus outside the editor, absent accessibility component state, or neither?
method: Run the original matrix through creation_focus_probe.py. Only on an original focus failure, read XGetInputFocus, editor window IDs, process status and AT-SPI state; preserve the original exception.
decisions: X11 focus outside the editor: inspect laboratory activation/ownership.
X11 focus on the editor with missing or contradictory accessibility state: investigate GTK/AT-SPI export/state.
No reproduced failure within three runs: inconclusive; retain unresolved limitation and all earlier failures.
qualification: Diagnostic passes do not resolve intermittent failures or qualify a complete edition.
observation: All three direct diagnostic wrapper runs passed the original checks. No focus failure was available for the added failure-time snapshot. Ordinary CTest failures remain unexplained.
